EVD-01.title: Run manifest is complete: tool and engine versions, URL and commit or content hash, viewport matrix, emulations, timestamps, evaluator providers and models, depth

EVD-02.title: Doctor smoke test passed in this session: each tool produced the expected detections on the known-bad fixture

EVD-03.title: Capture validity: no blank or near-uniform captures, correct dimensions, fonts loaded, animations settled, full-page captures start at the top

EVD-04.title: Every criterion has an explicit state backed by artifacts; `not_run` is never shown as pass; the WCAG coverage matrix is present

EVD-05.title: Every reported finding has a resolvable evidence anchor (selector resolves in the captured state, or a crop exists)

EVD-06.title: Report language matches evidence levels: no "users …" claims below E3, no causal claims below E5, no completeness claims, no synthetic metrics

EVD-07.title: Independence is recorded per evaluator (context isolation, provider, model, inputs given); DEGRADED banner present where isolation was not achieved

EVD-08.title: Freshness: every finding's fingerprint matches the current UI version, or the finding is marked `stale`

FUN-01.title: Every in-scope route loads (2xx) and renders its main content within the timeout

FUN-02.title: No uncaught exceptions or console errors during load and journey replay; console parity vs baseline

FUN-03.title: Every declared critical journey completes by scripted replay to its success condition

FUN-04.title: No broken images or media (`naturalWidth = 0`, failed requests) and no broken in-scope links

FUN-05.title: No horizontal page overflow at any matrix width (`scrollWidth ≤ clientWidth + 1`), except declared 2-D regions (data tables, maps, code)

FUN-06.title: No clipped or overlapping text at rest at any matrix width (overflow-hidden element whose scroll size exceeds client size; intersecting text boxes)

FUN-07.title: Lab Cumulative Layout Shift over load + scripted interactions

FUN-08.title: Lab LCP ≤ 2.5 s and INP ≤ 200 ms
FUN-08.threshold: advisory: never fails the gate; reported with the noise caveat

A11Y-01.title: axe-core with tags `wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa` over all in-scope states × {320, 1280} × shipped themes

A11Y-02.title: Every axe `incomplete` result is resolved by a scripted check or the accessibility auditor

A11Y-03.title: Keyboard: every interactive element is reachable; no trap; focus order follows visual order; no context change on focus

A11Y-04.title: Focus visible: every tab stop produces a visible change (focused vs blurred crop diff)

A11Y-05.title: Focus not obscured: the focused element is not entirely hidden by author content (Tab and Shift+Tab)

A11Y-06.title: Modal dialogs: focus moves in, Tab wraps inside, Esc closes, focus returns to the invoker; correct dialog semantics

A11Y-07.title: Reflow at 320 CSS px without two-dimensional scrolling (except 2-D content)

A11Y-08.title: Text-spacing override (line-height 1.5, paragraph spacing 2em, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em) causes no clipping or overlap

A11Y-09.title: 200% text resize: no clipping or overlap; controls operable

A11Y-10.title: Targets ≥ 24 × 24 CSS px unless an SC 2.5.8 exception applies (spacing circle, equivalent, inline, user-agent, essential)

A11Y-11.title: Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1; large text (≥ 24 px, or ≥ 18.66 px bold) ≥ 3:1; computed on the composited background in every state and theme; text over images or gradients pixel-sampled. CJK text from 18 to 24 px that is not already large text by the bold rule, with contrast between 3:1 and 4.5:1, goes to the accessibility auditor instead of being auto-passed or auto-failed, and 1.4.3 is recorded as agent-judged whenever such text is in scope (ADR-032)

A11Y-12.title: Non-text contrast ≥ 3:1 for component boundaries needed to identify controls, icons conveying meaning, graphical objects needed to understand content (chart marks, data points), focus indicators and state indicators

A11Y-13.title: Forms: visible persistent label for every input (no placeholder-only labels); errors in text with `aria-invalid` and programmatic association; focus moves to the first error or an error summary; `autocomplete` on personal-data fields

A11Y-14.title: Authentication: paste allowed in password and OTP fields; correct `autocomplete` tokens; no cognitive function test without an alternative or assistance mechanism (SC 3.3.8 exceptions for object-recognition and personal-content tests apply)

A11Y-15.title: Status messages from async actions are exposed through `role=status`, `alert` or a live region without moving focus

A11Y-16.title: `lang` present and matching the dominant script of the content; mixed-language runs tagged; Chinese tagged with a region or script subtag (`zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `zh-HK`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`), never bare `zh` when both scripts ship

A11Y-17.title: Pointer and keyboard static checks: no down-event-only activation, no unmodified single-character shortcuts without a remap or off switch, dragging has a single-pointer alternative, motion actuation has an alternative

A11Y-18.title: Cross-page consistency: navigation order, names of identical functions, help placement

A11Y-19.title: Colour is not the only visual means of conveying information: status, series, links and required markers stay distinguishable under deuteranopia, protanopia, tritanopia and achromatopsia emulation

A11Y-20.title: Coverage matrix: each of the 55 criteria labelled with how it was covered (auto, scripted, agent-judged, needs-human, not-tested) and its state; no "compliant" claim

A11Y-21.title: (L3) Needs-human criteria completed by a human: screen-reader pass of critical journeys, meaningful sequence, captions, sensory characteristics and similar

A11Y-27.title: No verified judged WCAG failure: success criteria without a dedicated G2 row (e.g. 1.3.4, 1.4.5, 1.4.13, 2.4.5, 2.4.6, 2.5.1, 2.5.3, 3.2.2, 3.3.3, 3.3.7) still fail G2 when a confirmed finding cites them
A11Y-27.threshold: 0 open confirmed findings citing a WCAG 2.2 A/AA criterion

TYP-01.title: Minimum rendered text size
TYP-01.threshold: no text < 12 px, except non-interactive legal or caption text ≥ 11 px; CJK text ≥ 12 px without exception

TYP-02.title: Body text size by mode
TYP-02.threshold: reading body ≥ 16 px (Persuade, Read, Experience); productive body ≥ 14 px (Operate); text inputs ≥ 16 px at widths < 768 px

TYP-03.title: Line height
TYP-03.threshold: Latin body text of 3 or more lines ≥ 1.4 (two-line UI text ≥ 1.3); multi-line CJK body text ≥ 1.5; wrapping headings ≥ 1.1 (Latin) or ≥ 1.2 (CJK, **[calibrating]**); line-height 1.0 on wrapping text ≥ 48 px fails

TYP-04.title: Measure (line length)
TYP-04.threshold: Latin prose fails when ≥ 2 rendered lines exceed 80 characters (target 45–75); CJK prose fails when ≥ 2 lines exceed 48 glyphs (target ≤ 40)

TYP-05.title: Type families
TYP-05.threshold: ≤ 2 families per script (Latin and CJK counted separately; fallback families in a stack are not counted) plus an optional monospace used only for code or data, unless `DESIGN.md` declares more with a reason

TYP-06.title: Hierarchy is not flat
TYP-06.threshold: with ≥ 3 text roles: adjacent role steps ≥ 1.25 (Persuade, Read, Experience) or ≥ 1.125 (Operate), or roles additionally separated by weight

TYP-07.title: No thin weights at small sizes

TYP-08.title: Tracking
TYP-08.threshold: lowercase body letter-spacing ≤ 0.05em; display ≥ −0.04em; CJK letter-spacing ≥ 0; no uppercase run > 30 characters

TYP-09.title: Display restraint
TYP-09.threshold: display text ≤ 6rem unless `DESIGN.md` declares it; a full-sentence h1 ≥ 72 px with ≥ 40 characters fails

TYP-10.title: Justification
TYP-10.threshold: justified Latin text requires `hyphens: auto`; pure-CJK paragraphs are exempt

COL-01.title: Token conformance
COL-01.threshold: ≥ 90% of colour declarations in component code reference tokens or variables; raw palette utilities (e.g. `bg-indigo-500`) and literal values outside token files are reported as drift unless listed in `DESIGN.md` exceptions **[calibrating]**

COL-02.title: No achromatic grey text on a chromatic background
COL-02.threshold: 0 offenders (text with OKLCH chroma < 0.005 on a surface with OKLCH chroma ≥ 0.05) **[calibrating]**

COL-03.title: Declared colour strategy is honoured
COL-03.threshold: Restrained: accent-hue area ≤ 10% of any viewport; Committed: dominant hue 30–60% of the surface; measured on screenshots with photos, video and illustrations masked. Full palette and Drenched are checked by advisory COL-17 **[calibrating]**

COL-04.title: Dark theme, when shipped, is composed
COL-04.threshold: `color-scheme` declared; elevated surfaces (cards, popovers, menus, dialogs, sheets) not darker than the base; sunken wells and inset inputs are excluded; all A11Y-11/12 checks pass in dark

LAY-01.title: Spacing scale conformance
LAY-01.threshold: ≥ 90% of margin, padding and gap values on the declared scale (by default: 0, 2 px, or a multiple of 4 px); off-scale values only as documented optical fixes **[calibrating]**

LAY-02.title: No spacing monotony
LAY-02.threshold: among ≥ 10 spacing declarations (deduplicated by class or rule signature, not by rendered instance), fail when one value accounts for > 60% and ≤ 3 distinct values are used

LAY-03.title: Heading rhythm
LAY-03.threshold: space above a section heading > space below it

LAY-04.title: No cramped padding
LAY-04.threshold: inside bordered or filled block containers: vertical inset ≥ max(4 px, 0.3em); horizontal ≥ max(8 px, 0.5em). Inline runs (`code`, `kbd`, `mark`, inline badges) are excluded

LAY-05.title: Edge margin
LAY-05.threshold: body text ≥ 16 px from the viewport edges at widths < 768 px

SHP-01.title: Concentric nesting
SHP-01.threshold: when an inset child's padding from the parent edge is smaller than the parent radius, the child's radius ≤ parent radius − padding; otherwise the child's radius ≤ the parent radius

SHP-02.title: Elevation economy
SHP-02.threshold: ≤ 4 distinct shadow styles in use per theme; no in-flow surface combining a ≤ 1.5 px border with a shadow blur ≥ 24 px **[calibrating]** (floating layers exempt); every non-focus shadow has at least one layer with a non-zero offset (spread-only rings count as borders)

MOT-01.title: Animated properties
MOT-01.threshold: no `transition: all`; no transitions or animations on layout properties (width, height, top, left, right, bottom, margin, padding)

MOT-02.title: Duration budget
MOT-02.threshold: state and feedback transitions ≤ 300 ms (≤ 250 ms on Operate surfaces); overlays (dialogs, drawers, popovers, menus) and page or view transitions ≤ 500 ms; background scrim dimming ≤ 700 ms; one declared focal entrance ≤ 800 ms; interactions declared frequent ≤ 150 ms. Continuous indicators (spinners, progress bars) are out of scope

MOT-03.title: No overshoot on UI state changes
MOT-03.threshold: no `cubic-bezier` with y1 or y2 outside [−0.1, 1.1], and no bounce or elastic animations, unless `DESIGN.md` declares a playful brand or the motion is gesture-driven

MOT-04.title: Reduced motion
MOT-04.threshold: every animation has a `prefers-reduced-motion` path; under emulated `reduce`, no infinite or large-displacement animation remains, except essential progress indicators, which may continue in a subtle, non-spatial form; ≤ 150 ms opacity or colour feedback may stay. Large displacement, measured while the animation runs under `reduce`: a translation of an element by ≥ min(200 CSS px, one third of the viewport along that axis); a scale change by ≥ 1.25× or ≤ 0.8× of an element whose box covers ≥ 25% of the viewport area; a rotation by ≥ 90°; or any movement of content in response to scroll (parallax, scroll-linked transforms) **[calibrating]** (ADR-032)

MOT-05.title: Content visible at rest
MOT-05.threshold: after load and a full scroll, no text remains hidden by an unfinished reveal animation

MOT-07.title: Mode budget
MOT-07.threshold: Operate and Read: no non-user-triggered choreography beyond one page fade; Persuade: ≤ 1 orchestrated sequence per screen; Experience: as declared in `DESIGN.md`, default ≤ 1 orchestrated sequence per screen

CMP-01.title: State styling exists
CMP-01.threshold: buttons, links and inputs show a visible difference for hover (when hover is supported) and active states (forced pseudo-state diff > 0)

CMP-02.title: Focus indicator quality
CMP-02.threshold: indicator ≥ 2 px thick (or area ≥ a 2 px perimeter), change contrast ≥ 3:1, distinct from hover — **advisory until calibrated**

CMP-03.title: Disabled states
CMP-03.threshold: disabled controls use ≥ 2 cues and stay perceivable: the label text or the outline of each disabled control reaches ≥ 2:1 contrast against the adjacent background **[calibrating]**, a floor of UI-Evaluator's own (WCAG exempts inactive components from 1.4.3 and 1.4.11). A primary submit button disabled at rest does not fail CMP-03; the check emits it as a candidate finding (H1, H9) for verification and rating (ADR-032)

CMP-04.title: Response feedback
CMP-04.threshold: a visible acknowledgement within 0.1 s of a user action; operations > 1 s show progress; operations ≥ 10 s show determinate progress (or percent done) and a way to cancel or interrupt; a static "Loading…" alone fails

CMP-05.title: Data states exist
CMP-05.threshold: every data view in scope has loading, empty and error states, demonstrated through state recipes or confirmed by the code reviewer

CMP-06.title: Touch-primary targets
CMP-06.threshold: on touch viewports, the hit area of each primary control is ≥ 44 × 44 CSS px, and the shortest edge-to-edge distance between the hit areas of neighbouring primary controls is ≥ 8 CSS px **[calibrating]**. Touch viewports: matrix entries captured with touch emulation (`hasTouch`, `pointer: coarse`), by default every width below 1024 CSS px. Primary controls: a surface's primary action (`PRODUCT.md` or `config.json`), controls used by journey steps, primary navigation items, form submit buttons and dialog action buttons; inline links in running text are excluded. Hit area: the element's border box, united with its associated `<label>` box for inputs (ADR-032)

CPY-01.title: No placeholder text shipped
CPY-01.threshold: 0 occurrences of lorem ipsum, TODO, TBD, template braces and similar, outside visibly labelled placeholders

CPY-02.title: Descriptive link text
CPY-02.threshold: 0 links whose accessible name is only "click here", "here", "read more" or "learn more" without context (zh: 点击这里, 点此, 这里, 更多, 了解更多 without context). Implements WCAG 2.4.4 (Level A), so it cannot be waived

CPY-03.title: Case consistency
CPY-03.threshold: one case convention per element type (buttons, headings, navigation) across the run scope

CPY-04.title: Error-message quality
CPY-04.threshold: 0 generic, blaming or code-only messages in exercised error states: "An error occurred", "Invalid", "Oops", "Something went wrong" without a fix, "forbidden", "illegal", "you forgot", a raw error code alone; zh equivalents as listed in `cjk.md`. ("please" and "sorry" for user errors are advisory, CPY-09)

I18N-01.title: Explicit CJK font stack
I18N-01.threshold: content CJK text resolves through declared CJK families (e.g. PingFang SC → Hiragino Sans GB → Microsoft YaHei → Noto Sans SC); `system-ui` and `ui-sans-serif` are not the content face

I18N-02.title: Regional families
I18N-02.threshold: Traditional Chinese pages use TC/HK families, never SC

I18N-03.title: Restricted fonts not self-hosted (all locales)
I18N-03.threshold: SF Pro/New York, Segoe UI, PingFang, Microsoft YaHei and GDS Transport are referenced by local name only

DEC-01.title: `PRODUCT.md` complete
DEC-01.threshold: required fields present, including surfaces with their single job and mode; inferred facts labelled; a facts section (claims the UI may make) present

DEC-02.title: `DESIGN.md` complete and valid
DEC-02.threshold: lints clean (`@google/design.md lint` when available, otherwise the bundled validator); references the surfaces and modes in `PRODUCT.md`; declares brand attributes as "X, not Y", colour strategy, voice and tone positions, type roles and scale, spacing, radius, elevation and motion tokens

DEC-03.title: Direction record for new work or redesigns
DEC-03.threshold: ≥ 2 directions elaborated (3 dealt by default); category default and predictable opposite named as off-limits; convergence tests (similar-prompt, category-guess, swap) recorded with revisions; choice and rationale recorded; roll seed recorded

DEC-04.title: Ledger variety for new work
DEC-04.threshold: the newest entry of the project ledger (`.ui-evaluator/ledger.json`) differs from the 3 entries before it (all of them when there are fewer) in display face and macrostructure, unless the brand pins them; `not_applicable` when the project ledger has no earlier entry (first direction in this project). Repeats found in the opt-in cross-project ledger (`~/.ui-evaluator/ledger.json`) are listed in the criterion's detail as advisory and never change its state (ADR-034)

SLP-01.title: Gradient text
SLP-01.threshold: `background-clip: text` with a gradient on the same element

SLP-02.title: Default indigo-violet accent
SLP-02.threshold: gradient stops or filled CTA backgrounds in the indigo-violet band (OKLCH hue 260–310° with chroma ≥ 0.10 and lightness 0.25–0.85 **[calibrating]**, or HSL hue 250–310° with saturation > 0.25 and 0.15 < L < 0.85), or `from-/to-/bg-{purple,violet,indigo}-*` utilities on calls to action, when the hue is not in the documented brand palette

SLP-03.title: Emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons
SLP-03.threshold: emoji or pictographic glyphs used as icons, bullets or navigation prefixes (chat and user content exempt)

SLP-04.title: Decorative side stripe
SLP-04.threshold: coloured side border ≥ 3 px (≥ 2 px if rounded), or ≥ 2× the other sides, on non-semantic cards, callouts or list items

SLP-05.title: Eyebrow or kicker labels
SLP-05.threshold: short uppercase or tracked label (≤ 14 px, letter-spacing ≥ 0.06em, 2–34 characters) directly above an h1–h4 ≥ 20 px, used more than ceil(sections ÷ 3) times on a page or split into a different grid column; any pill or eyebrow above an h1 ≥ 48 px

SLP-06.title: Icon-tile feature template
SLP-06.threshold: ≥ 3 equal sibling cards, each with a 32–128 px near-square icon tile above a heading

SLP-07.title: Card kit
SLP-07.threshold: a card-like element nested in a card-like ancestor; or identical `box-shadow` on ≥ 4 cards together with one radius ≥ 16 px on > 80% of rounded elements

SLP-08.title: Decorative glow
SLP-08.threshold: zero-offset chromatic shadow (CIE LCh chroma ≥ 30, blur > 4 px); chromatic blurred shadow on a ground with luminance < 0.1; chromatic radial washes behind heroes, unless named in the direction

SLP-09.title: Uniform entrance animation
SLP-09.threshold: the same entrance keyframes or variants on ≥ 3 sections

SLP-10.title: Fake chrome
SLP-10.threshold: traffic-light title bars, mock URL pills, CSS or SVG device frames, div-built "screenshots" of dashboards or terminals

SLP-11.title: Simulated liveness
SLP-11.threshold: pulsing dots, blinking cursors outside inputs, marquees, count-up numbers not tied to live data

SLP-12.title: Fabricated proof
SLP-12.threshold: numbers, "trusted by" logo sets, testimonials, ratings, badges or customer names absent from the facts section and not labelled as placeholders

SLP-13.title: Placeholder identities
SLP-13.threshold: "Jane Doe", "John Smith", "Acme", `example.com` addresses and similar in shipped UI outside labelled demo data

SLP-14.title: Copy tells
SLP-14.threshold: buzzword or theatre-phrase hits; ≥ 3 aphoristic constructions; generic hero copy; ≥ 8 em dashes at ≥ 1 per 500 characters of Latin-script text (the Chinese 破折号 —— is standard punctuation and is not counted)

SLP-15.title: Generic CTA set
SLP-15.threshold: the only calls to action are generic ("Get started", "Learn more" and equivalents)

SLP-20.title: Saturated display or only face without a recorded reason (dated list)

SLP-21.title: Second-order house looks when unrequested: cream ground + high-contrast serif + terracotta; near-black + single acid accent; broadsheet hairlines + italic serif + tracked mono labels

SLP-22.title: SaaS hero formula: badge + oversized centred headline + two CTAs incl. gradient primary + decorative orb + generic copy

SLP-23.title: Radius monotony: > 80% of non-zero radii share one value ≥ 16 px without a documented system

SLP-24.title: Mixed icon libraries, or default glyphs in default roles

SLP-25.title: Structure that carries no information: 01/02/03 markers on non-sequential content, monospace meta labels, unmotivated italic accent word in a headline

SLP-26.title: Motion clichés: image hover zoom, uniform hover-scale on unrelated elements, > 1 simultaneous hover property change

USE-01.title: Heuristic-evaluation protocol
USE-01.threshold: standard depth: ≥ 3 isolated evaluators, 2 passes each (flow pass, then element pass), one problem per record, principle cited, context packet given

USE-02.title: Consolidation
USE-02.threshold: deterministic-key merge done; any-two agreement and detection counts reported

USE-03.title: Verification
USE-03.threshold: every reported finding passed the verification chain: evidence resolves, behaviour exercised, harness artefact excluded, in scope, absence claims backed by positive evidence

USE-04.title: Blind severity
USE-04.threshold: ≥ 3 independent raters per confirmed finding; validity votes, the mean of problem and trade-off values, spread and factors stored; spread ≥ 2, or a `not_a_problem` vote against a mean ≥ 2.5, marked divergent

USE-05.title: No open P0
USE-05.threshold: 0 findings with mean severity ≥ 3.5 in status open, in_progress, blocked, fixed, reopened, disputed or deferred. A P0 cannot be deferred to pass this criterion, and waiting on a decision (blocked, ADR-036) does not pass it either

USE-06.title: Every P1 has a decision
USE-06.threshold: each P1 is `verified`, `deferred` (reason, owner, revisit trigger), `disputed` with a study planned, or `wont_fix` as a justified trade-off

USE-07.title: Cognitive walkthrough of critical journeys
USE-07.threshold: each critical journey walked with persona, task and correct action sequence fixed first; four questions per step; no failed step left without a decision

USE-08.title: Task suitability
USE-08.threshold: every declared top task can be completed with what the UI offers

USE-09.title: Interaction coverage
USE-09.threshold: ≥ 90% of salient interactive controls in scope exercised or explicitly out of scope **[calibrating]**

USE-11.title: AI features audited (when the UI contains AI features)
USE-11.threshold: every AI feature checked against HAX G1–G18, with explicit prompted checks for G5, G6 and G11 and PAIR error classification; `not_applicable` when there are no AI features

DES-01.title: Panel protocol
DES-01.threshold: standard depth: ≥ 3 isolated critics; no build transcript; specificity written before detector output is shown; screenshots from the full matrix

DES-02.title: Specificity verdict
DES-02.threshold: a majority of critics judge the design specific to this product, citing evidence from the swap, category-guess and similar-prompt tests

DES-03.title: No agreed severe design finding
DES-03.threshold: 0 open design findings with mean severity ≥ 3 that were raised by ≥ 2 critics or confirmed by the verifier against the rendered UI, unless decided (as USE-06). A single-critic finding the verifier marks `needs_human` is not agreed

DES-04.title: Brand fit
DES-04.threshold: a majority of critics judge the declared "X, not Y" attributes as reflected, citing elements

DES-05.title: Not worse than baseline (redesigns)
DES-05.threshold: pairwise comparison with the baseline in both orders; only order-consistent preferences count, and a preference that flips with order counts as a tie; the new version is preferred or tied by the majority

DES-07.title: Appeal verdict
DES-07.threshold: a majority of critics judge the design `appealing` (finished, cared for, attractive to its audience, with visual interest its mode allows), written before detector output is shown and citing elements; `plain` and `unappealing` name the signs of unfinish

EMP-01.title: Study plan
EMP-01.threshold: objectives → research questions → participants → tasks with success criteria → measures → analysis plan → ethics and consent; flat incentives

EMP-02.title: Formative round
EMP-02.threshold: moderated round with about 5 participants for a single primary user group (3–4 per group when two groups are tested; ≥ 3 per group for three or more); think-aloud; neutral probes; clue-free tasks from the journeys

EMP-03.title: Observed problems integrated
EMP-03.threshold: each logged with k/n; merged with analytical findings; severity re-rated with observed frequency

EMP-04.title: Critical tasks succeed
EMP-04.threshold: in the latest round, each critical task completed without assistance by ≥ 80% of participants (e.g. ≥ 4 of 5); no open observed severity-4 problem

EMP-05.title: Fixes re-tested
EMP-05.threshold: every observed problem of severity ≥ 3 fixed and re-tested with users; fix confidence 1 − (1 − p)^n reported

EMP-06.title: Honest metrics
EMP-06.threshold: task success with 95% adjusted-Wald CI; SEQ mean with CI; SUS with CI if collected; time as geometric mean; no NPS or SUS reported from a 5-user formative round as a benchmark

EMP-07.title: (optional) Desirability
EMP-07.threshold: share of participants choosing ≥ 1 pre-registered on-brand word from a ~25-word reaction-card list (~40% negative); 5-second test

EMP-08.title: (optional) Experiment validity
EMP-08.threshold: pre-registered success metric and guardrails; power analysis; SRM check passed; fixed horizon or always-valid inference
